verdict.rationale: Ente Auth is an end-to-end encrypted 2FA service with sync and a CLI, so scoped API credentials for agents is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no API keys, tokens, or permission scoping for programmatic or agent access. The CLI is export and backup tooling, and temporary share links for specific codes are a different feature, not scoped API credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
